title: Jesus Saves
lyrics_original: We have heard the joyful sound:
Bear the news to every land,
Climb the mountains, cross the waves;
Waft it on the rolling tide:
Tell to sinners far and wide:
Sing, you islands of the sea;
By His death and endless life,
Shout it brightly through the gloom,
When the heart for mercy craves;
Sing in triumph o'er the tomb:
Give the winds a mighty voice:

bible_verses.english: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to condemn the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given among men by which we must be saved!”
He said to them, “Go into all the world, and preach the Good News to the whole creation.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for the incredible gift of salvation that transformed my life. Fill my heart with fresh joy today for the good news of Your grace. Give me the courage and compassion to share Your love with those around me, both in gentle words and loving actions. May my life be a joyful testimony that You are alive and faithful to save. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: The good news of Jesus Christ is not a secret to be kept, but a joyful message meant to be shared with the whole world. When we sing "Jesus saves," we celebrate the incredible grace that rescued us and continues to reach out to every broken heart. Christ invites us today to carry this hope across every boundary—in our words, our kindness, and our daily lives. May our hearts overflow with gratitude as we echo His love to everyone around us.
